The Department of Homeland Security dumping out video footage of it is the obvious tell they're forcing a narrative to paint these agencies as helpful when the real goal is controlling the public through these fake incidents at airports and borders. Don't buy the official line at all—hidden elites are flipping the story to bury their actual motives and keep everyone distracted from the bigger picture.
